function: Excluded: learned complex NN only estimates target AoA and AoD from the LS channel estimate, direction-of-arrival estimation alone; no beams, waveforms or resources designed (pp. 1, 4, 6).
notes: Excluded under function. p. 1: "joint angle of arrival and angle of departure estimation problem for bistatic ISAC systems"; p. 6: output layer of 2 neurons for AoA and AoD; p. 4: "a radar unit is installed to estimate the sensing parameters". The system is communication-centric ISAC, but the learned part serves sensing only and no communication metric is reported. Borderline: the reviewer may read it as ISAC area 5. If kept: q1 0 (custom bistatic channel, pp. 3-4), q2 0 (SNR sweep only, p. 10), q3 doubtful (non-learned 2D algorithm plus the authors' own MLP and CONV variants, no earlier learned method, Fig. 7 on p. 11), q4 1 (p. 12, multiplications and additions), q5 1 (p. 10, GitHub link).
